name: CLIN final model (stage 8e-4)
decision: D8.14 (model selected by the D8.8 rule on the CLIN nested CV); frozen before any CLIN held-out data are read

training_set.source: data/processed/split_clin.parquet (split == 'train') joined to data/processed/features_clin.parquet on stay_id
training_set.stay_id_sha256_definition: sha256 of np.sort(stay_id).tobytes() (int32), as in the 04f cache meta
training_set.candidate_matrix_sha256_definition: sha256 of the candidate columns (order below) as a C-contiguous float64 array, rows in split order; identical to the 04f clinical cache meta data_sha

steps: 1. 20% missing-rate rule (src.preprocess.missing_filter, threshold 0.20) computed on the 2,045 training patients; the 8 WBC-differential variables are exempt (D8.4 method 2)
2. Imputation fitted on the training set (src.preprocess.impute_scale: mean for continuous, mode for MODE_VARS; D3.3); fill values stored for application to new data
3. Standardisation fitted on the imputed training set (mean, population SD); stored
4. LASSO: src.lasso.cv_lasso on the standardised training set, inner 10-fold stratified CV, seed 42, glmnet lambda grid; selected variables = non-zero coefficients at lambda.1se

5. Recommended model LR (L2): src.models.tuning_grids(p, 42)['LR'] = LogisticRegression(l1_ratio=0.0, max_iter=10000), grid C in [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, 100, inf]; GridSearchCV(cv=StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), scoring='roc_auc', refit=True) on the standardised selected variables
6. Comparator tuned RF: src.models.tuning_grids(p, 42)['RF'] (n_estimators 500, random_state 42; max_features grid adapted to p), same GridSearchCV, on the imputed (unstandardised) selected variables
7. If LASSO selects no variable, stop (no model is frozen) and report

thresholds.definition: pooled-OOF Youden threshold of the CLIN nested CV, median over the 5 repeats (results/clinical/nested_cv_full_oof_threshold_clin.csv); positive if p >= threshold

outputs.fit_record: results/clinical/final_model_clin.json (aggregate: selected variables, lambda, C, RF parameters, events, EPV, bundle sha256)

holdout: data/processed/split_clin.parquet split == 'valid' (512 patients); evaluated once by scripts/04i_holdout_clin.py after this file and the fit record are committed
